A conventional two-sample $t$-test yields $p = 0.318$ (not significant), illustrating the distinction between absence of evidence for a difference and evidence of equivalence: the TOST procedure provides the latter.

\subsection{Global Multiple Comparison Correction}
\label{sec:bonferroni_correction}

The paper reports 63 statistical tests spanning permutation tests, $t$-tests, bootstrap comparisons, TOST equivalence, and Spearman correlations.
We apply a Bonferroni correction ($\alpha_{\text{adj}} = 0.05 / 63 = 7.94 \times 10^{-4}$) and the less conservative Holm--Bonferroni step-down procedure; both yield identical results.
Of the 45 originally significant tests, 40 survive correction (88.9\%).

All eight core tests supporting the paper's main claims remain significant:
RSA permutation at L12 ($p < 0.0001$), trained vs.\ untrained image geometry at L12 ($p = 3.9 \times 10^{-5}$), counterfactual wrong and empty instruction ($p < 10^{-100}$), TOST cross-architecture equivalence ($p < 0.0001$), dose-response top-24 ablation ($p < 10^{-100}$), trained vs.\ untrained probe $R^2$ ($p < 0.0001$), and bottom-24 specificity ($p < 10^{-90}$).

Five auxiliary tests lose significance under correction:
(i)~RSA trained vs.\ untrained preaction at L12 ($p = 0.005 \to p_{\text{adj}} = 0.284$),
(ii)~DINOv2 vs.\ SigLIP RSA ($p = 0.032 \to p_{\text{adj}} = 1.0$),
(iii)~fused backbone vs.\ SigLIP RSA ($p = 0.011 \to p_{\text{adj}} = 0.673$),
(iv)~CV exact paired permutation ($p = 0.016 \to p_{\text{adj}} = 0.984$),
and (v)~$R^2$ projector vs.\ VLA Spearman correlation ($p = 0.003 \to p_{\text{adj}} = 0.183$).
These concern auxiliary comparisons (encoder ranking, coefficient-of-variation ordering) rather than the core redistribution, probing, or counterfactual findings; no main-text conclusion requires revision.

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
story_arc:
  hook: >
    VLAs fine-tune LLMs on robot demonstrations, but do the internal mechanisms
    they learn generalize across architectures—or are they artifacts of a specific backbone?
  gap: >
    Prior behavioral studies (Grant 2026, Haon 2025) revealed visual dominance and
    sparse directions in single VLAs, but no work has tested whether instruction routing
    mechanisms are architecture-specific or universal, nor decomposed what training creates
    vs what it inherits from the base model.
  insight: >
    Two training effects are architecture-independent (R² exit collapse, counterfactual
    sensitivity), while L1 head count is base-model-dependent. A three-tier gradient
    (VLM → OXE-pretrained → task-finetuned) shows routing emerges at the VLM→VLA
    transition and reshapes with task specialization.
  evidence: >
    R² exit collapse: trained Δ=0.12-0.69 vs untrained Δ=0.01-0.08, 9/10 matrix cells.
    CF sensitivity: trained 7-10× untrained across 3 architectures.

1	Vision-language-action models (VLAs) fine-tune large language models on robot demonstrations, but what fine-tuning changes at the representational level remains unclear.
2	We decompose two causal-decoder VLAs---OpenVLA-7B and TraceVLA---across all 32 LLM layers using cross-instruction probes, attention analysis, and functional probes, with factorial trained/pretrained/untrained controls on LIBERO.
3	Three findings emerge.
4	First, VLA fine-tuning redistributes instruction attention from mid-depth to entry-exit layers, supported by seven complementary analyses including dose-response and counterfactual ablation.
5	Second, despite dramatically different untrained profiles (OpenVLA peaks at L0 then collapses; Phi-3-V ramps to L6), both architectures reach similar trained mid-layer peaks ($R^2$ $0.637$ vs.\ $0.634$, $\Delta = 0.003$), consistent with a shared reorganization pattern toward a common functional organization; training effects concentrate at the readout token ($+0.069$) rather than image geometry.
6	Third, token-level analysis confirms expected functional specialization---image tokens remain instruction-blind while the readout token integrates multimodal information---consistent with the causal attention mask and serving as a framework sanity check.
7
